concerns.text: The plan lists the Elastic Modulus dataset as "OQMD – Elastic Modulus (same OQMD repo, different column)". OQMD does not provide elastic modulus values; the intended source per the research block is the Materials Project. Using an incorrect dataset would invalidate the mechanical‑property evaluation.

The plan states that it will enforce "≥ 500 test samples per dataset (to satisfy FR‑008)". FR‑008 actually requires ≥ 300 test samples for the power analysis. The wording misrepresents the functional requirement.
